text_to_image_prompt: Adult woman with pale warm skin, hazel-gray eyes, balanced oval face, softly full pink lips, long honey-beige blonde layered wavy hair with an off-center part. Ivory open cardigan, horizontal charcoal and white striped fitted top, ivory high-waisted wide-leg trousers tied at waist, closed-toe dark shoes. Slender natural adult proportions. Single full-length front view, whole body including shoes visible, relaxed straight standing pose and natural balanced head/body proportion. Premium semi-realistic 2.5D/3D romance-game character rendering, finely modeled face, soft matte skin microtexture, detailed hair strands and fabric, broad soft frontal illumination, pure white studio background, no additional people, logos or watermark.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied finished full-body female character image. Change ONLY the two shoes at the bottom: replace the black open-toe sandals with simple elegant black leather CLOSED-TOE flats with a gently almond-shaped toe, fully opaque solid uppers covering all toes. No toes or toenails visible, no peep-toe opening. Keep shoe height and footprint approximately the same and let the existing white trouser hems drape naturally over them. Preserve everything above the shoe area exactly: the same woman's face, hair, expression, head size, neck, body proportions, height, pose, hands, striped cream knit top, hip sash, white wide-leg pants, cloth folds, lighting, high-quality otome 2.5D/3D rendering, white background and shadows. Same complete 1024x1536 2:3 canvas and same framing, no cropping, no rescaling, no new objects or text. Local footwear replacement only.
